title: Scalable Delphi: Large Language Models for Structured Risk Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2602.08889v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Quantitative risk assessment relies on structured expert elicitation to estimate unobservable properties. The Delphi method produces calibrated, auditable estimates but requires months of coordination and specialist time, placing rigorous risk assessment out of reach for most applications. We propose Scalable Delphi, adapting the classical protocol for LLMs with diverse expert personas, iterative refinement, and rationale sharing. Beyond lowering cost, this makes the assessment analyzable and dynamic. Rationales and revision histories record what each estimate rests on, information can be ablated to test which evidence matters, and the elicitation can be rerun with new evidence, changed assumptions, or adverse scenarios. translated_title: 可扩展德尔菲法：用于结构化风险估计的大语言模型
translated_abstract: 定量风险评估依赖于结构化的专家征询来估计不可观测的属性。德尔菲方法能够产生经过校准、可审计的估计结果，但需要数月的协调工作和专家时间投入，使得严格的风险评估对大多数应用来说难以企及。我们提出了可扩展德尔菲法，将经典协议适配到大语言模型上，采用多样化的专家角色、迭代优化和理由共享机制。除了降低成本之外，这还使评估过程变得可分析且动态化：理由和修订历史记录了每个估计所依据的信息，可以通过信息消融来检验哪些证据是重要的，并且可以在新证据、变更假设或不利情景下重新运行征询过程。由于目标量在构造上是不可观测的，我们设计了一个基于任何可靠估计器必须满足的必要条件的评估框架：在可验证替代指标上的准确性和校准性，以及对扰动的敏感性。
tldr: 提出可扩展德尔菲法，通过大语言模型扮演多样化专家角色并进行迭代优化和理由共享，大幅降低了结构化风险估计的成本，使评估过程可分析、可动态更新，并设计了基于必要条件的评估框架来验证估计器的可靠性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Scalable Delphi, which adapts the classical Delphi protocol to LLMs with diverse expert personas, iterative refinement, and rationale sharing, making structured risk estimation cheaper, analyzable, and dynamically rerunnable, supported by a necessary-condition-based evaluation framework for estimator reliability.
